observation: Actual registered Triops WATER_AMBIENT plus WaterAnimal placement helper is separate from reproduction. Food callback/pair/egg/hatch code does not call NaturalSpawner cap admission; this does not prove universal engine/cross-mod cap bypass or a runtime opportunity.

Target item goal chooses nonempty age>10 items by canTargetItem and nearest squared distance in radius9 cube. At distanceSquared<2 and empty mainhand it calls onGetItem then unconditionally shrink1 and stops; owner/pickup delay/food-success are not checked at this sink. Navigation results ignored; small mob path-done can stop pursuit. Timing/random gating and ten-worldtime branch are not an exact ten-tick schedule.

Triops dropped-item callback gates EAT/sound/heal request and server fedCarrot on isEdible and nonnull foodProperties, with breedCooldown==0. Larva plain Item(new Properties()) has baseline null food; it can be targeted/consumed without those callback effects. Actual tag contains carrot and nested forge carrot crop tag; no larva direct entry. Resource declaration is not loaded-tag/native success.

Player interaction calls super first; if unconsumed, qualified target shrinks1 unless instabuild, then EAT/sound/heal request; only POST-SHRINK stack tag membership sets fedCarrot, even during cooldown. Native ItemStack count<=0 resolves getItem to AIR and tag test uses that item: with count1 noncreative carrot and a loaded breed tag excluding AIR, the post-shrink breeding-tag test no longer identifies carrot. This is a bounded static ordering inference, not reproduced gameplay or a claim all datapacks exclude AIR.

Pair initiator canUse reserves selected partner by writing partner.breedWith=this. Mate predicate is alive/water/fed/cooldown<=0, no baby/pregnancy/reservation checks; continuation separately rejects pregnancy and own breedWith!=null. Within1.2 it broadcasts heart and marks only initiator pregnant. stop consumes initiator fed flag and random1200..4799 cooldown even on interruption; does not clear own/partner reservation or passive partner food. This permits asymmetric retained lock/food in shown class, not proof all mating stalls: reserved mates may still be selected by another initiator.

Pregnancy survives own NBT/bucket serialization, but breedWith and goal partner reference do not. Persistent pregnancy is not itself in requiresCustomPersistence or removeWhenFarAway exemption: those check inherited passenger, bucket, baby and fed flag. After initiator stop clears fed, an otherwise ordinary adult pregnant creature can still reach native distance/event despawn. No claim it always despawns or that all reasons are controlled.

LayEggGoal at pregnant and random1/30 samples at most10 XZ offsets[-5,4] starting currentY+10 then descends through air; accepts air with water-tag below. Continue only rechecks eggPos air, not below-water viability. Within squared distance2 it clears pregnancy BEFORE setBlockAndUpdate and ignores boolean; a failed or later-invalid placement need not restore pregnancy. No ongoing pair/quorum/native success receipt.

Inherited Frogspawn onPlace schedules virtual tick with default random[3600,12000); setters can alter defaults. Inherited survival requires exact WATER Fluid type below and EMPTY fluid at egg, stricter than WATER tag. updateShape can turn invalid egg AIR and falling-block collision destroys it. Triops override does not invoke vanilla hatch audio/random tadpole offset.

Triops egg tick destroys egg first, then attempts2or3 registered Triops create (null guarded). Each nonnull gets raw x/z,Y-.5, random yaw, setPersistenceRequired flag and BabyAge=-12000 then unchecked addFreshEntity. No finalizeSpawn/checkSpawnRules/obstruction/success-committed retry in shown hatch sink. Egg disappearance and attempt count do not prove offspring count or strict kills.

Complete Triops tick decrements positive breeding cooldown but never increments BabyAge; immediate WaterAnimal/PathfinderMob parents are not AgeableMob. No claim all external event/tick hooks cannot alter age, nor runtime forever-baby proof. Hatched persistenceRequired true bypasses native ordinary-distance branch independently of baby flag, while external removal/peaceful/event paths retain their limits.
Native hatch override first calls destroyBlock; its boolean result is not checked. Report the destruction request/order, not guaranteed removal or committed offspring.
Hatched child setPersistenceRequired(true) bypasses the shown native Forge despawn-event and ordinary distance branches through their outer guard. This is not protection against every removal path.
